coreLearnings.content: QA covers both shopro-res (Spring Boot backend) and shopro-res-web (React frontend)
Backend: Spring Boot 3.x, 317 Java files, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets
Frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, 517 TSX/TS files
Critical flows: KDS real-time updates, inventory FIFO tracking, purchase order 3-way matching, table session management
Security: OAuth2, JWT/DPoP, 2FA via Google Authenticator
AI features: Invoice OCR, 3-way matching - need special QA attention
Business simulation: Inventory scenarios need validation
Key integrations: Frontend-Backend API contracts, WebSocket STOMP messages
Seeders provide test data: Afghan ingredients, dashboard, menu costing, experiments
Deployment: Backend Docker, Frontend Docker + nginx

patternsEstablished: QA should verify: API responses match DTO contracts, WebSocket messages arrive correctly
Test data: Use seeder classes to create consistent test data
Performance: Check Redis caching, database query optimization
Security: Verify auth flows, token expiration, role-based access
Mobile/POS: Test on different screen sizes (NEXGO EF60 terminal mentioned)
knownPitfalls: WebSocket tests need special tooling for STOMP
AI feature testing needs ground truth datasets
Consider performance testing for simulation module
Missing automated regression tests for critical flows
